title: Spicy Korean Free Bowl
description: A spicy and flavorful bowl dish inspired by Korean cuisine. This recipe combines the crunch of seeds with the spiciness of Korean chili flakes.

ingredients.name: Seeds
ingredients.notes: such as sesame seeds or pumpkin seeds

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add free and cook according to package instructions.
Add seeds and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and serve.
